about: CORNET: a from-scratch low-poly model (studio/tools/models/cornet_model.py), centred on its bounding box and scaled to fit a unit sphere, in TRUMPET.json's frame (bell at +x, valve buttons up)

fields.P: the face's vertices, k x 3 (x, y, z; y up), in drawing order (a fan from the first vertex)
fields.emit: its colour is used as it is, unshaded
fields.gid: group id: 1 marks the ground group, anything else is the instrument (the sprite renderer maps it to 2)

name: CORNET
note: faces are in the order the model builder made them; the sprite renderer draws them in this order (a later face wins only where it is strictly nearer).
